addon.notes:
# New
* Added a Tag filter to Library and Inventory views which lets you filter items based on tags.
* In the tag editor, you can now drag selected items into any tag in the left tag list to add them directly there.
* Consolidate now lets you check off multiple items to add to the queue when filtering by Items.
* Added a Pass option to the right-click "Add To List" menu in Library mode.
* Added an optional Auto-Update feature in Currency that automatically updates the UI based on a user-defined cadence.
* Pool auto-pass now defaults to on.

# Bugfixes
* Fixed a bug where the Distribute To... window could close shortly after doing a huge distribution operation.
* Fixed Library mode resetting custom window sizes when navigating back and forth between it.
* Fixed Library right-click menu getting cut off when opened at the bottom edge of the window.
* Fixed being unable to use some temporary items such as Revitalizer.
